verdict.rationale: Bland provides an extensive documented public API for programmatic control (pathways API, batch calls, webhooks, evals, custom API tools) plus a CLI and MCP server for agent-driven access, all clearly documented across docs.bland.ai. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s on standard OpenAPI paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
